COP31 Debates Climate Finance Amidst El Nino and Fossil Fuel Tax Calls

The COP31 climate conference is facing increased pressure to address climate finance, with calls to 'make polluters pay' by taxing fossil fuels to fund climate action. The ongoing El Nino phenomenon is raising the stakes for the discussions. Separately, the COP32 climate conference is noted to be occurring amidst shocks to Africa's food systems.
